test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). S is sitting third to the left of V. T is sitting second to the right of S. P is sitting fourth to the right of Q. U is sitting second to the left of P. What is the position of R with respect to T?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

S is sitting third to the left of V. T is sitting second to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5aefc192a314be578cd411a19f5892dd527d03d2a2b99eece3ecf3f2f08b096.png] 

P is sitting fourth to the right of Q. U is sitting second to the left of P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7db38f93c553e83f3d8add9a119f7a64fdd8b1240359cbfa64603a40fe27e20f.png] 

Thus, the R is the Third to the right of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
